description:
Answer an open planning question and release its roadmap item.

    Use this for a `list_escalations` row with reason
    `expand_needs_clarification` (its `next_tool` names this tool). The
    planner asked one or more product questions about one roadmap item; give
    ONE answer that covers every question (1-4,000 characters). The answer is
    stored with the item, the card is resolved, and the next planning run of
    that item reads the answer. It is stored once: a second answer to the
    same round is refused. Requires the personal connection of an active
    workspace owner; a workspace key or a member who is not an owner is
    refused. A paused project refuses until it is resumed. A refusal returns
    ok=false with a fixed `refusal_code`, and nothing is stored.
    `resolve_escalation` does not answer a planning question.
name: answer_planning_question
title: Answer Planning Question
